title: Senator cussed out by Curtis LeMay over secret Wright-Patterson room
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Senator cussed out by Curtis LeMay over secret Wright-Patterson room, about unspecified (Cold War) at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I called Curtis LeMay and I said, General, I know we have a room at Wright-Patterson where you put all this secret stuff.

tellings.difference: Here the unnamed politician tells it in the first person and adds that LeMay told him never to ask that question again. The story's telling is the host quoting the senator, with only a vague Cold War date.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe the same incident: a senator asks Curtis LeMay for access to the secret room at Wright-Patterson and LeMay angrily cusses him out. The quote is nearly word for word the same.
